title: What's my archetype?
lines: The Hero, the Lover, the Sage: which one runs your chart?
caption:
What's your archetype? ✦

An archetype is a character the whole world recognizes: the Hero, the Lover, the Sage. Astrology has read the signs and planets this way for centuries, and your chart is the cast you were born with. Every archetype has a gift and a shadow.

Ask the Oracle: what's my archetype? Link in bio.
